reuse.why: The link path calls the existing shared assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank and linkAccountAndSync like the other providers; only the download side does not reuse anything.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a condensed copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (same token check, POST, error check and result mapping) instead of a shared download for this response format.

placement.why: Link wrapper in accounts/app.ts beside the other providers, download in sync.ts with dispatch in syncAccount, server URL in server-config, account type in types/models.

scope.why: Only the provider wiring and its tests; the extra updatedPreview in an existing mock is a trivial test fix.

maintainability.why: The link side is a thin, uniform wrapper; the copied download function is one more place to keep in step with Akahu's.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Linking goes through assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkAccountAndSync; no shared download helper exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions reformats and trims downloadAkahuTransactions (drops the 'error' branch and log, inlines objects) rather than sharing it.
